Package com.rocket.radar.uml

Annotation Interface UmlCompose

@Retention(CLASS) @Target(FIELD) public @interface UmlCompose
Annotation to mark fields that represent a composition relationship in UML diagrams. This is used for documentation purposes to indicate that one class owns instances of another class, where the contained objects cannot exist independently of the container.
